## Checklist

- [ ] One logical change; commit messages follow the house style (`docs(spec): …`, `design: …`)
- [ ] Decisions changed → the spec is updated, with the alternative that was rejected
- [ ] Screens changed → boards rebuilt with `node .design/build_pages.mjs` and committed
- [ ] New claims cite their source
- [ ] A working session that future contributors need to know about has a journal entry
- [ ] Nothing here includes a real person's data, a model key, or an image without its licence
